title: Monthly Roadmap Thermometer & Action Tracker for Exec Readout
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Purpose: Create a repeatable ‘thermometer’ one-pager and accompanying action tracker to surface initiative health signals for monthly exec readouts and QBR prep. The artifact should make it trivial for execs to see which roadmap items are green/amber/red, why, what mitigation is in flight, and what decisions or escalations are needed.

Scope: cover all active product initiatives owned by PM + top customer-facing engineering projects that affect SLAs, Dedicated/Private launches, and Optimize features. Provide a single slide + a short decision log and an attached tracker with owners and due dates.

Success criteria: template accepted by PLs and Eng leads, used in at least two monthly readouts, and reduces ad-hoc status requests from execs by 40%.

Key artifacts (initial drafts): Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/roadmap-thermometer-draft, Slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/thermometer-draft, Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/roadmap-tracker.

Notes on approach: We will synthesize signals from: OKR progress (percent complete), runtime metrics (latency tail, error rates), Dedicated capacity adoption (% reserved), and quality regressions from Redwood Optimize alerts. Each initiative will have a 1-line rationale for current status and a 2-week mitigation plan if amber/red.
acceptance_criteria: Thermometer slide template finalized and uploaded to Confluence
Action tracker populated for 12 prioritized initiatives with owners and due dates
Template reviewed and sign-off from two Eng PLs and VP Product
At least one monthly exec readout uses the artifact and records decisions in the decision log

action_items: Priya - validate observability query for SLO snapshot and schedule weekly run (due 2026-03-14)
Marco - finalize slide visual and export PNGs for Confluence (due 2026-03-11)
Liam - populate tracker with owner names and target dates for each mitigation (due 2026-03-13)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Observability pipeline (ENG-4210) misses snapshot window -> Mitigation: use last successful run and mark stale
Risk: Execs request additional deep-dive data -> Mitigation: prepare 2 backup deep-dive slides (performance and cost tradeoffs)
Risk: Too many open actions obscuring decisions -> Mitigation: cap action items per initiative to 2 and escalate remainder to PLs
outcome: Deliver a concise, decision-oriented thermometer + living action tracker that reduces status friction and surfaces escalations with clear owners. Plan to iterate after two readouts based on exec feedback.
notes: Follow-up: schedule a short rehearsal 2026-03-11 with VP Product and Eng PLs. After first use, collect exec feedback via a 3-question survey and update template by 2026-04-01.
